svg.title: SFLP structure and validation
svg.desc: An SFLP is a COSE_Encrypt structure with protected Origin Domain, Attribute Set, Lease Reference and content type, an encrypted Non-Captive LKAI body, and COSE Recipients. The Target Key Service decrypts and verifies it, checks the three bindings against the Retrograde request, and applies its Policy before granting access.

g.aria-label: Encrypted SFLP_Body; Non-Captive LKAI; Lease Key + Base IV
COSE Recipients; kid = recipient FPK’s FKID
Use Federation Secret Key; Decrypt + verify SFLP; Check request bindings; Apply local Policy
A random CEK encrypts the body.; Recipient entries enable the; intended Domains to recover it.
Illustrative structure; field encoding is specified in the text
